chemical.alt: Delta A(nu,t) = [H(nu) exp(-t/tau_H) + R(nu) exp(-t/tau_R) + C(nu)] u(t)

bin.alt: Recorded bin mean equals the time integral over the bin divided by Delta t.

ifg.alt: Interferogram I(x,t) is the cosine transform of single-beam spectrum S(nu,t).

shift.alt: OPD displacement is twice mirror displacement, in matching length units. Shift is expanded through fourth order.
shift.latex: $\delta x=2d,\qquad I(x+\delta x,t)\simeq\sum_{m=0}^{4}\frac{(\delta x)^m}{m!}\frac{\partial^m I(x,t)}{\partial x^m}$

sampling.alt: Spatial sampling frequency Fs is 1/Delta x = 2B; desired band is B to 2B.

alias.alt: q(nu) = abs(((nu + B) modulo 2B) - B); displayed wavenumber is 2B - q.

leak.alt: Observed Delta A = -log10[(S0 times 10 to minus true Delta A + leakage L)/(S0 + L)].

small.alt: For a small signal, Delta A approximately equals -Delta S divided by ln(10) S0.

period.alt: Period is 1/f; cycle count is f times the time window; phase timing shift is Delta phi/(360 degrees times f).

steady_zero.alt: For zero true change, the same steady leakage in both records gives zero observed difference absorbance.

dilution.alt: For a small difference signal, the observed amplitude is scaled by S0 divided by S0 plus steady leakage.

demo_local.alt: A small mirror displacement d changes the AC detector signal by twice d times the local OPD derivative about common mirror bias b.

demo_real.alt: For fixed real readout and stationary biased reference, difference absorbance is minus log10 of cos(kappa times bias plus drive) divided by cos(kappa bias).

coadd.alt: Average the N detector or intensity records first, then form difference absorbance against the declared reference.

phase_factor.alt: Intensity harmonic m has phase-coherence factor C_m; a 0 and pi phase pair cancels odd orders and retains even orders.
